label: Health & the Human Body
scope_note: The human body, its functions and disorders, and the practices — across medical traditions — that maintain health and treat illness.

label: The human body
scope_note: The structure and function of the human body.

label: Human anatomy
scope_note: The structure of the human body, its organs and systems.

label: Human physiology
scope_note: How the human body works: circulation, respiration, digestion, metabolism and the other systems.

label: Medicine
scope_note: The diagnosis, treatment and prevention of disease as practised in modern biomedicine and its specialties.

label: Internal medicine
scope_note: Diagnosis and non-surgical treatment of diseases of adults' internal organs.

label: Surgery
scope_note: Treatment by operating on the body.

label: Paediatrics
scope_note: Medical care of infants, children and adolescents.

label: Obstetrics and gynaecology
scope_note: Pregnancy, childbirth and the health of the female reproductive system.

label: Psychiatry
scope_note: The medical diagnosis and treatment of mental disorders.

label: Neurology
scope_note: Disorders of the brain, spinal cord and nerves.

label: Cardiology
scope_note: The heart and blood vessels and their diseases.

label: Oncology
scope_note: Cancer: its biology, diagnosis and treatment.

label: Immunology
scope_note: The immune system in health and disease.

label: Pharmacology
scope_note: How drugs act on the body, their development, safety and use.

label: Dentistry
scope_note: The teeth, mouth and jaws and their care.

label: Geriatrics
scope_note: Medical care of older people.

label: Diseases and disorders
scope_note: Conditions that impair the normal functioning of body or mind, and how they are classified.

label: Infectious diseases
scope_note: Diseases caused by bacteria, viruses, fungi and parasites, and how they spread.

label: Noncommunicable diseases
scope_note: Long-lasting diseases not passed between people, such as cardiovascular disease, cancers, diabetes and chronic respiratory disease.

label: Genetic disorders
scope_note: Conditions caused wholly or partly by variants in genes or chromosomes.

label: Injuries
scope_note: Physical harm from accidents, violence and other external causes.

label: Mental health
scope_note: Psychological and emotional well-being, mental disorders, and the care and support available across societies.

label: Public health
scope_note: Protecting and improving the health of whole populations.

label: Epidemiology
scope_note: How diseases are distributed in populations and what determines them.

label: Global health
scope_note: Health as a worldwide concern: inequalities between and within countries, and cooperation to address them.

label: Health systems and policy
scope_note: How health care is organized, financed and delivered in different countries.

label: Vaccination and immunization
scope_note: Vaccines and immunization programmes.

label: Water, sanitation and hygiene
scope_note: Safe drinking water, sanitation and hygiene, and their effect on health.

label: Nutrition
scope_note: Food and nutrients in relation to health, growth and disease.

label: Sexual and reproductive health
scope_note: Health in matters of sexuality and reproduction, including contraception, fertility and pregnancy.

label: Nursing and care
scope_note: Nursing and the wider work of caring for the sick, the disabled and the dependent, paid and unpaid.

label: Traditional and complementary medicine
scope_note: Medical systems and healing practices outside modern biomedicine, many of them centuries old; this category records the practices, while claims about their effects are kept as attributed statements.

label: Ayurveda
scope_note: The traditional medical system of the Indian subcontinent.

label: Traditional Chinese medicine
scope_note: The traditional medical system of China, including herbal therapy and acupuncture.

label: Unani medicine
scope_note: The Greco-Arabic medical tradition practised in South and West Asia.

label: Traditional African medicine
scope_note: The healing traditions of African societies, combining herbal knowledge, diagnosis and spiritual practice.

label: Death and dying
scope_note: The biology of death, dying, and end-of-life and palliative care.
